name: Wibbly-wobbly, Timey-wimey
oracle_text:
Time travel. (For each suspended card you own and each permanent you control with a time counter on it, you may add or remove a time counter.)
Draw a card.
blocked_sentences: Time travel. (For each suspended card you own and each permanent you control with a time counter on it, you may add or remove a time counter.)

needs.what: an op that, for each suspended card the controller owns (in exile, with suspend, with a time counter) and each permanent they control with a time counter on it, lets them choose to add one time counter, remove one, or do nothing; removing the last time counter from a suspended card must cast it without paying its mana cost as suspend does (702.62), through the same counter-removed funnel
needs.why_existing_wont_do: No time_travel op is in reference. for_each + choose_mode over add_counters/remove_counters is the near miss, but no selector key reads 'suspended' (has_counters: "time" in exile also matches non-suspended exiled cards), and the free cast on removing the last counter lives only in suspend's upkeep tick, so an effect removing it would strand the card in exile. "Draw a card." alone is a plain draw op.
